purpose: Add governed texture classes as a separate deterministic projection over the verified VM81 sprite-gradient framebuffer while preserving the inherited renderer and VM81 execution authority.
governing_rule: Texture may enrich the user-visible projection but may not create hidden gameplay state, mutate authoritative state, obscure collision semantics, or replace modality-matched evidence.

authority.output: 160x144 RGBA8888 plus Hash72 and Hash216 frame identities
authority.projection_invariant: The texture module first receives the exact inherited HHS_VM81_SPRITE_OVERLAY_ALL frame, then applies additive texture pixels while the complete release state remains byte-identical.
forbidden: external texture assets without identity and provenance
media rendered from a different state sequence than the receipt-bound capture

compatibility.inherited_behavior: The original atmosphere, phase, glow, HUD, vignette, hashes, and tests remain source- and behavior-frozen.
compatibility.additive_rule: Texture is a second projection over the inherited RGBA frame and never reinterprets inherited overlay flags.

texture_classes.name: INTERFERENCE_FIELD
texture_classes.projection: Deterministic micrograin and dual modular wave interference reinforce the visible phase-rotation curvature without changing the base atmosphere gradient.

texture_classes.name: PARALLAX_MIDGROUND
texture_classes.projection: Slow camera-divided arches, lattice lines, and distant structural bands form a non-collidable depth plane behind the level geometry.
texture_classes.readability_constraint: Must remain lower contrast than solid terrain and hazards.

texture_classes.name: TERRAIN_MATERIALS
texture_classes.projection: Surface grain, edge seams, strata, veins, and cracks are applied inside already-solid tiles.
texture_classes.readability_constraint: Textures reinforce tile boundaries and may not alter the collision silhouette.

texture_classes.name: SEMANTIC_ENERGY
texture_classes.projection: Hazard interference bands, checkpoint harmonic rings, and goal attractor rays communicate danger, activation, and terminal direction.
texture_classes.readability_constraint: Hazards remain immediately dangerous-looking; checkpoint intensity reflects activation; goal intensity exceeds checkpoint intensity.

texture_classes.name: PLAYER_MATERIAL
texture_classes.projection: Suit panel segmentation, phase accents, rim highlights, and motion echoes enrich the player while preserving its 16x16 silhouette.
texture_classes.readability_constraint: Player silhouette and facing direction remain dominant over ornament.

render_order: non-collidable parallax midground on unoccupied pixels
terrain and hazard material detail inside inherited geometry
player material segmentation and motion echoes

arithmetic.gameplay: unchanged exact integer and fixed-subpixel VM81 state
arithmetic.texture: integer coordinate hashing, modular lanes, integer interpolation, and integer alpha blending only
arithmetic.determinism: Same release state and flags produce byte-identical RGBA output and identical Hash72/Hash216 identities.

required_invariants: the inherited gradient composite remains independently reproducible
the inherited sprite renderer source, output hashes, tests, and presentation evidence remain unchanged
each texture class can be enabled independently
each texture class produces a distinct frame identity
all five texture classes emit nonzero native write counts
invalid flags and insufficient capacity fail without state mutation
authoritative movement changes the texture projection
texture layers never alter level occupancy or collision geometry
the full frame stream remains ordered and Hash72/Hash216 chained
screenshots and MP4 derive from the exact native texture frame sequence
presentation evidence binds to victory, two checkpoints, 19/19 opcode coverage, replay MATCH, final Hash72, and final Hash216
negative_tests: zero native write count for an enabled texture class
video frame-count, frame-rate, resolution, duration, or codec mismatch
